title: Watercolor "Sunny Oak" 98 Scrub Oak Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Lake District of WaterColor- Access to WaterColor Beach Club- 6- Passenger low speed vehicle- 3 outdoor porches- 5 adult bikes- 2 dedicated parking spaces- Bunk room with large attached playroom/teen hangout room- Complete Clean Linen Participant--ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Discover your next adventure in "Sunny Oak," a 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home nestled on a tranquil street in WaterColor's Lake District. This inviting space exudes coastal charm, providing a happy retreat for guests. Families can easily access Camp WaterColor, tennis courts, Western Lake, and playgrounds via scenic nature paths. The award-winning community offers a plethora of amenities for all ages.Step inside to find a spacious living area seamlessly connected to a gourmet kitchen adorned with cheerful decor and premium stainless-steel appliances. The breakfast bar and dining table, seating 3 and 8 respectively, invite guests to create and enjoy meals together. The kitchen opens to a back patio and grilling deck. A guest room with a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a full laundry room, add to the home's convenience.Upstairs, three more spacious guest rooms await. The luxurious primary suite boasts natural light, a private balcony, and a bathroom with a shower and separate clawfoot tub. Another king bedroom shares a hallway bathroom with the bunk room, featuring two twin-over-double bunk beds and a queen sleeper sofa. The last bedroom includes an additional seating area and a flat-screen TV.Embrace laidback, breezy Florida living on the front and back porches throughout all four seasons. A porch swing and grill offer guests a relaxing outdoor experience after a day at the beach. With access to the WaterColor Beach Club's pools, restaurants, and sun decks, guests can enhance their beach stay. From the warm, salty air to diverse activities like shopping, dining, and biking, WaterColor has it all. Secure your stay at "Sunny Oak" with today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, En Suite Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk beds and Queen Sleeper Sofa and attached Playroom- Daybed with TrundleWeddings or events are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Unfortunately, we cannot allow animals in this home. Failure to adhere to this rule will allow immediate eviction.
